description: This file defines a final class 'Message' in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace that provides static methods for handling HTTP messages, including serialization to string, body summarization, message parsing, and request/response object creation.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Provides static methods for serializing, parsing, and manipulating HTTP messages in string and object formats.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts an HTTP message object to its string representation, including request line/status line, headers, and body.

methods.name: bodySummary
methods.description: Returns a short summary of the message body, truncated at a specified length, or null if not printable.

methods.name: rewindBody
methods.description: Rewinds the message body stream if it is seekable and not at the beginning.

methods.name: parseMessage
methods.description: Parses a raw HTTP message string into an associative array with start-line, headers, and body.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses a raw HTTP request string into a RequestInterface object.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses a raw HTTP response string into a ResponseInterface object.
